svg.title: Plot booking
svg.desc:
A · Separate booking screen - place: Plot list - affordance: Search plots (field) - affordance: Book a plot - affordance: Garden rules (link) - place: Booking - place: Plot form (in Booking) - affordance: Your name (field) (in Plot form) - affordance: Check the map (in Plot form) - place: Map (in Booking) - affordance: Confirm - affordance: Back to plots - place: Receipt - affordance: Done - affordance: Book another plot - place: Waiting list - place: Rules - arrow: Book a plot → Booking - arrow: Garden rules → Rules - arrow: Check the map → Map - arrow: Confirm → Receipt - arrow: Confirm → Waiting list - arrow: Back to plots → Plot list - arrow: Done → Plot list - arrow: Book another plot → Plot list
B · Inline booking - place: Plot list - affordance: Book a plot (chevron) - place: Booking (in Plot list) - affordance: Share with a neighbour (checkbox) (in Booking) - affordance: Confirm (in Booking) - place: Receipt - arrow: Book a plot → Booking - arrow: Confirm → Receipt
